Inferxe AI & Cloud GPU Marketplace Overview:
INFERXE WEBSITE OVERVIEW & PURPOSE:
Inferxe (inferxe.com) is India's premier sovereign cloud GPU infrastructure and LLM inference marketplace platform. The website allows AI startups, enterprises, developers, and researchers to discover, compare, size, and deploy high-performance NVIDIA GPUs (such as H100 SXM, H200, B200, L40S, L4, and A100) with one-click Docker and vLLM containerized serving. Key Website Modules & Navigation:
- Home (/): Platform highlights, sovereign cloud infrastructure, real-time GPU availability, and key value propositions.
- Platform (/platform): Intermediary orchestration engine, automated model-to-GPU sizing, and cluster management.
- Solutions (/solutions): Tailored solutions for startups, enterprise AI, healthcare, fintech, and fine-tuning.
- Pricing (/pricing): Transparent hourly on-demand and spot rates in Indian Rupees (INR) and USD, prepaid wallet system.
- GPU Catalogue (/gpus): Complete specifications, VRAM, interconnects, and pricing across all supported NVIDIA GPUs.
- How It Works (/how-it-works): 4-step onboarding from account setup to one-click model deployment.
- Developers (/developers): OpenAI-compatible REST API documentation, Python SDK snippet, and curl examples.
- Roadmap (/roadmap): Development phases from MVP launch to multi-provider federation and distributed clusters.
- Company (/company): Mission, vision, Indian data sovereignty commitment, leadership, and Noida headquarters.
- Security (/security): Tier-IV datacenter facilities in Noida and Mumbai, DPDP Act compliance, SOC2, and zero cross-border data egress.
- Contact (/contact): Enterprise inquiries, sales, and 24/7 technical support.
- Dashboard & Workspace (/dashboard): Real-time instance management, simulated wallet balance, hourly burn rate tracker, and JupyterLab/SSH access.

Inferxe Home Page Features & Highlights:
INFERXE HOME PAGE DETAILS:
- Hero Section: 'Next-Gen Sovereign GPU Cloud for AI & LLM Inference'. Instant provisioning of frontier NVIDIA GPUs with lowest latency in India.
- Core Value Proposition: Eliminates infrastructure complexity. Users do not need to configure bare-metal drivers, CUDA, or vLLM runtimes manually.
- Interactive GPU Studio: Allows users to test model prompts and compare token generation latency directly on the website.
- Real-Time Telemetry: Live indicators of GPU cluster health, active nodes, and sub-25ms Time-To-First-Token (TTFT).
- Trusted by Enterprises: Compliant with Indian regulatory standards (MeitY empanelment, DPDP Act 2023).

Inferxe Platform Architecture & Capabilities:
INFERXE PLATFORM ARCHITECTURE PAGE:
- Architecture Layers: Built on a 4-layer stack: 1) Presentation Layer (React + TypeScript SPA), 2) Orchestration Engine (FastAPI & intermediate routing), 3) GPU Infrastructure Layer (JarvisLabs.ai integration and bare-metal nodes), 4) LLM Serving Engine (vLLM with continuous batching and PagedAttention).
- Intermediary Model: Inferxe acts as an intelligent intermediary. Users specify their workload requirements (model parameters, context length, budget), and the platform automates GPU selection and instance deployment.
- High-Throughput Serving: Native integration with vLLM enables continuous request batching, reducing inference cost per token by up to 60% compared to traditional cloud providers.
- Containerization: Deployments run inside optimized Docker containers with pre-installed PyTorch, CUDA 12.x, and Hugging Face weights cache.

Inferxe Solutions for Startups, Enterprises & Research:
INFERXE SOLUTIONS PAGE:
- AI Startups: Cost-effective spot instances and per-minute billing for fast experimentation without upfront commitments or long-term contracts.
- Enterprise Production AI: High-availability dedicated clusters (99.9% SLA), guaranteed capacity reservations, and strict data privacy.
- FinTech & Healthcare: Indian sovereign data residency ensuring sensitive user records, prompts, and embeddings never leave Indian soil.
- AI Researchers: Multi-GPU nodes over NVLink (H100 SXM5 / B200) for training, LoRA fine-tuning, and massive Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models.

Inferxe Pricing Model, Rates & Wallet System:
INFERXE PRICING PAGE DETAILS:
- Billing Model: Per-minute granular billing with zero hidden egress fees and no lock-in commitments.
- Documented Listing Rates (INR & USD):
 * NVIDIA L4 (24 GB GDDR6): ₹60/hour ($0.72/hr) — Best for 7B-8B models, audio/video AI, and embeddings.
 * NVIDIA L40S (48 GB GDDR6 ECC): ₹100/hour ($1.20/hr) — Best for 14B-32B models and LoRA fine-tuning.
 * NVIDIA A100 80GB (80 GB HBM2e): ₹141/hour ($1.49/hr) — Proven foundation model serving and distributed training.
 * NVIDIA H100 SXM5 (80 GB HBM3): ₹275/hour ($3.30/hr) — Frontier 70B+ inference with FP8 Transformer Engine.
 * NVIDIA H200 SXM (141 GB HBM3e): ₹435/hour ($4.59/hr) — Extreme 128k long-context reasoning without out-of-memory errors.
 * NVIDIA Blackwell B200 (192 GB HBM3e): ₹650/hour ($7.80/hr) — Massive Mixture-of-Experts (DeepSeek-V3, Llama 405B).
- Spot Instance Discounts: Up to 50%-56% savings on interruptible batch workloads.
- Prepaid Wallet System: Users top up their balance in INR. The platform displays real-time hourly burn rates and estimates remaining runtime.

Inferxe GPU Catalogue Specifications & Comparison:
INFERXE GPU CATALOGUE PAGE:
The GPU catalogue presents side-by-side hardware specifications, benchmarks, and availability:
- NVIDIA L4: 24 GB GDDR6, 300 GB/s bandwidth, 242 FP16 TFLOPS, 72W low TDP, PCIe Gen4 single-slot.
- NVIDIA L40S: 48 GB GDDR6 ECC, 864 GB/s bandwidth, 366 FP16 TFLOPS, 350W TDP, PCIe Gen4.
- NVIDIA H100 SXM5: 80 GB HBM3, 3350 GB/s (3.35 TB/s) bandwidth, 989 FP16 TFLOPS, 1979 FP8 TFLOPS, 700W TDP, NVLink 4 (900 GB/s).
- NVIDIA H200 SXM: 141 GB HBM3e, 4800 GB/s (4.8 TB/s) bandwidth, 700W TDP, NVLink 4.
- NVIDIA Blackwell B200: 192 GB HBM3e, 8000 GB/s (8.0 TB/s) bandwidth, 2250 FP16 TFLOPS, 4500 FP8 TFLOPS, NVLink 5 (1800 GB/s).
- Users can filter GPUs by VRAM, architecture (Hopper, Ada Lovelace, Blackwell, Ampere), interconnect type, and price range.

How Inferxe Works — 4 Step Deployment Workflow:
HOW INFERXE WORKS (4-STEP WORKFLOW):
1. Step 1: Select Workload & Model — Choose your open-source model (Llama 3.1, Qwen 2.5, DeepSeek, Mistral) or custom PyTorch container.
2. Step 2: Automated GPU Sizing — Inferxe automatically calculates required VRAM (Weights + KV-Cache + 2.5GB overhead) and recommends the most cost-effective GPU.
3. Step 3: One-Click Instant Provisioning — The platform provisions the GPU through JarvisLabs.ai infrastructure and deploys Docker with vLLM in under 60 seconds.
4. Step 4: Connect & Scale — Receive a production-ready, OpenAI-compatible API endpoint with API key and monitoring telemetry.

Inferxe Developer SDK, API Endpoints & Code Examples:
INFERXE DEVELOPERS PAGE & API INTEGRATION:
- Base URL: https://api.inferxe.com/v1
- OpenAI SDK Drop-in Replacement: Change only base_url and api_key to switch any existing application to Inferxe.
- Python Code Example:
```python
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(
 base_url='https://api.inferxe.com/v1',
 api_key='ix_live_your_api_key_here'
)
response = client.chat.completions.create(
 model='meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct',
 messages=[{'role': 'user', 'content': 'Hello Inferxe'}],
 stream=True
)
for chunk in response:
 print(chunk.choices[0].delta.content or '', end='', flush=True)
```
- cURL Example:
```bash
curl https://api.inferxe.com/v1/chat/completions \
 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer ix_live_your_api_key_here' \
 -d '{"model": "Qwen/Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Hi"}]}'
```
- Features: Token streaming (Server-Sent Events), latency metrics, usage tracking, and batch inference.

Inferxe Dashboard, Workspace & Wallet Management:
INFERXE DASHBOARD & WORKSPACE FEATURES:
- Dashboard Overview: Shows total active GPU instances, current hourly burn rate (e.g. ₹160/hr), available wallet balance, and cluster uptime.
- Marketplace Workspace (/dashboard/marketplace): Search and provision GPUs, select OS templates (Ubuntu, PyTorch, vLLM, Ollama), configure SSH public keys, and attach NVMe volume storage.
- Instance Lifecycle Control: One-click Start, Stop, Restart, and Terminate instance controls to manage infrastructure spending.
- Integrated Web Terminal & JupyterLab: Access running GPU instances directly from your browser without third-party SSH clients.
- Team & User Access Control (/dashboard/users): Invite team members, configure Role-Based Access Control (Admin, Developer, Viewer), and manage API keys.
- Wallet & Billing (/dashboard/wallet): Top up balance with UPI, NetBanking, Credit Cards, or Wire Transfer; view transaction history and invoices.

Inferxe Security Standards & India DPDP Act Compliance:
INFERXE SECURITY & SOVEREIGNTY PAGE:
- Indian Data Residency: 100% of GPU compute and data storage is hosted domestically in Tier-IV datacenter facilities in Noida (NCR) and Mumbai.
- DPDP Act 2023 Compliance: Fully compliant with India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act. Customer data, prompts, model weights, and telemetry never leave Indian territory.
- Infrastructure Security: Isolated VPC networking, encrypted NVMe disks at rest (AES-256), TLS 1.3 encryption in transit, and role-based access control.
- No Training on Customer Data: Inferxe guarantees zero data retention for model retraining. Your proprietary prompts and inference data are never used for training.

About Inferxe — Mission, Leadership & Location:
ABOUT INFERXE (COMPANY PAGE):
- Mission: Democratize high-performance AI compute for India and global emerging markets by providing friction-free, sovereign GPU access.
- Headquartered: Noida, Uttar Pradesh (Delhi NCR), India.
- Vision: Build India's foundational AI infrastructure layer so startups and developers can innovate without exorbitant foreign cloud bills or latency.
- Partnerships: Partnered with top-tier datacenters and infrastructure providers including JarvisLabs.ai for high-availability GPU supply.
- Careers & Community: Active open-source AI community and developer programs.

Contact Inferxe, Sales Inquiries & Technical Support:
INFERXE CONTACT & SUPPORT PAGE:
- General & Sales Inquiries: sales@inferxe.com or submit the website contact form at /contact.
- Technical Support: 24/7 engineering support available for enterprise customers and active deployments.
- Community Channels: Official Inferxe Discord and Slack channels for developer assistance, sizing advice, and updates.
- Custom Enterprise Deployment: Dedicated account managers for multi-node H100 clusters, private VPC interconnects, and annual capacity contracts.

Payment Process & How to Use Wallet on Inferxe:
Login or Sign Up: First, you need to log in or sign up using your credentials at [Sign In](/login).

Inferxe Account Creation, Login & Portal Access:
ACCOUNT CREATION, LOGIN & ACCESS:
- Access Portal: Visit /login to sign in or register a new developer or enterprise account.
- Sign Up: Enter your Full Name, Email, Password, and Organization.
- User Roles: Customer (launch instances, manage wallet, generate API keys), Provider (list GPU nodes), Admin (platform telemetry).
- Unlocked Features after Login: Full access to the GPU Marketplace (/dashboard/marketplace), Prepaid Wallet Top-up (/dashboard/wallet), Instance Start/Stop lifecycle controls, SSH Key Management, and OpenAI-compatible API key generation.

For fine-tuning with AdamW (16-bit), add 16-20 bytes per parameter for optimizer states, gradients, and activations, or use QLoRA (4-bit base + FP16 adapters) to train 70B on 48GB VRAM.

Add 20% overhead for CUDA context and activations. KV Cache memory = 2 * Layers * Heads * Head_Dim * Precision * Context_Length * Batch_Size. For fine-tuning with AdamW (16-bit), add 16-20 bytes per parameter for optimizer states, gradients, and activations, or use QLoRA (4-bit base + FP16 adapters) to train 70B on 48GB VRAM.
Source: https://inferxe.com/docs/vram-math
